title: Property CLI reads file uploads from EOF
summary: The file helper seeks to EOF for size but never rewinds before read; nonempty script/BLOB uploads return-2 and the failure path leaves the handle open. Actual indigo_uni_seek uses lseek/_lseek. Check size and seek errors, rewind, close on every outcome, terminate text, and add nonempty upload/failing-read cleanup regressions. Next action: coordinator assigns a focused repair and relevant regression.
